arStrings.szText: That was Demeas. A brilliant scholar, excellent archivist, and someone I thought I could trust. But if even he is swayed by Akarat?
exasperated, frustrated. Hushed tone as Demeas is nearby.

Ever since Akarat arrived, the scholars have been behaving…differently. They question long-held histories and toss aside anything that doesn’t align with Akarat’s teachings. I...I cannot support that.
Continue bringing me any findings you come across. I’ll compile them in a chronicle and ensure that the information is kept somewhere safe.
